zh-CN.headlineFact: 规则、基础设施与韧性成为共同主线
zh-CN.headlineView: 增长正在补齐运行底座
zh-CN.headlineFull: 规则、基础设施与韧性成为共同主线；增长正在补齐运行底座
zh-CN.intro: 小包裹关税、AI透明、单人企业税务、空间站维护、气候与公共卫生共同显示：新增长必须建立可持续的运行底座。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 真正长期的增长，不只靠新机会，也靠清晰规则、可靠设施与可复用流程。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 跑得快之前，先把路、护栏和维修站建好。

en-US.headlineView: growth is rebuilding its operating foundations
en-US.headlineFull: Rules, infrastructure and resilience converge; growth is rebuilding its operating foundations
en-US.intro: Small-parcel duties, AI transparency, solo-business tax, station maintenance, climate and public health show that new growth needs durable foundations.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Long-term growth needs not only opportunities, but clear rules, reliable infrastructure and reusable processes.
en-US.doudouQuote: Before going faster, build the road, guardrails and repair stations.

sources.title: China to expand cross-customs return policy for e-commerce exports
Members discuss preparations to bring E-Commerce Agreement into force by mid-2027

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟低价值小包裹将征收3欧元关税
zh-CN.headlineView: 低价直邮成本模型需要重算
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟低价值小包裹将征收3欧元关税；低价直邮成本模型需要重算
zh-CN.intro: 欧盟通过新规则，计划自2026年7月起对直接寄给消费者、价值低于150欧元的小包裹按商品类别征收3欧元关税。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 跨境卖家要把关税、拆包方式、客单价和履约路线放进同一张利润表。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 每包多3欧元，选品和合单策略都会变。

en-US.headlineFact: EU adds a EUR3 duty to low-value parcels
en-US.headlineFull: EU adds a EUR3 duty to low-value parcels; direct-shipping economics need recalculation
en-US.intro: The EU adopted rules applying a EUR3 duty per item category to parcels under EUR150 sent directly to consumers from July 2026.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Cross-border sellers must model duty, parcel structure, basket size and fulfillment route in one margin calculation.
en-US.doudouQuote: Three euros per category can change both assortment and consolidation.

sources.title: WCO Framework of Standards on Cross-Border E-Commerce

zh-CN.headlineFact: 欧盟AI透明义务进入生效后的首周
zh-CN.headlineView: 生成内容披露成为产品功能
zh-CN.headlineFull: 欧盟AI透明义务进入生效后的首周；生成内容披露成为产品功能
zh-CN.intro: 自8月2日起，部分AI交互以及生成或操纵内容面向欧盟用户时需要更清晰的身份披露、标识与来源说明。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 透明不是发布末端补一枚水印，而是模型输出、界面和审计链共同承担的产品能力。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 让AI内容先说明自己是谁、从哪里来。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：人工智能 AI。

en-US.headlineFact: EU AI transparency duties enter their first week
en-US.headlineFull: EU AI transparency duties enter their first week; disclosure becomes a product feature
en-US.intro: From August 2, certain AI interactions and generated or manipulated content shown to EU users require clearer disclosure, marking and provenance.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Transparency is not a final watermark; it is a product capability spanning model output, interface and audit trail.
en-US.doudouQuote: Let AI content say what it is and where it came from.

sources.title: Commission opens consultation on draft guidelines for AI transparency obligations

zh-CN.headlineFact: 美国税局更新单成员LLC办税说明
zh-CN.headlineView: 一人公司先搭合规操作系统
zh-CN.headlineFull: 美国税局更新单成员LLC办税说明；一人公司先搭合规操作系统
zh-CN.intro: IRS说明单成员LLC通常按忽略实体处理，但雇佣税和部分消费税仍以独立实体申报，经营者需分清税务身份与责任。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 一人公司越轻，账户、税种、合同与记录越要提前模块化。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 人可以只有一个，账本不能只有一本糊涂账。
zh-CN.footerTakeaway: 今日关键词：一人公司 OPC。

en-US.headlineFact: IRS refreshes single-member LLC tax guidance
en-US.headlineView: solo firms need a compliance operating system
en-US.headlineFull: IRS refreshes single-member LLC tax guidance; solo firms need a compliance operating system
en-US.intro: The IRS says a single-member LLC is usually disregarded for income tax, while employment and certain excise taxes still use separate-entity treatment.
en-US.xiaziQuote: The leaner the company, the more deliberately accounts, taxes, contracts and records should be modularized.
en-US.doudouQuote: One owner is fine; one confused ledger is not.

zh-CN.headlineFact: NASA准备8月三次空间站太空行走
zh-CN.headlineView: 轨道基础设施进入密集维护期
zh-CN.headlineFull: NASA准备8月三次空间站太空行走；轨道基础设施进入密集维护期
zh-CN.intro: NASA将直播三次美国太空行走，任务涉及空间站外部维护与升级，首场计划于8月6日展开。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 太空探索的日常，不只是在发射台上突破，也是在轨道上持续检修。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 能长期住在太空，靠的是一次次把螺丝拧紧。

en-US.headlineFull: NASA prepares three August spacewalks; orbital infrastructure enters intensive maintenance
en-US.intro: NASA plans live coverage of three U.S. spacewalks for station maintenance and upgrades, with the first scheduled for August 6.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Space exploration advances not only at launch, but through continuous repair and upgrading in orbit.
en-US.doudouQuote: Living in space depends on tightening the next bolt.

zh-CN.headlineFact: 两颗新伽利略卫星正式投入服务
zh-CN.headlineView: 欧洲导航星座继续扩容
zh-CN.headlineFull: 两颗新伽利略卫星正式投入服务；欧洲导航星座继续扩容
zh-CN.intro: 欧洲航天局宣布两颗新伽利略卫星进入服务，为全球用户增强定位、导航和授时能力，并提升星座整体韧性。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 关键基础设施的进步，常不是一次惊艳发布，而是持续增加覆盖、冗余与可靠性。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 多两颗星，地面上的路线就多一层把握。

en-US.headlineFact: Two new Galileo satellites enter service
en-US.headlineFull: Two new Galileo satellites enter service; Europe expands its navigation constellation
en-US.intro: ESA says two new Galileo satellites have entered service, strengthening positioning, navigation and timing for users worldwide and adding resilience.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Critical infrastructure improves through steady gains in coverage, redundancy and reliability, not only dramatic launches.
en-US.doudouQuote: Two more satellites give routes on Earth another layer of confidence.

sources.title: Two new Galileo satellites enter service

zh-CN.headlineFact: 斯里兰卡为反式脂肪监管强化实验室能力
zh-CN.headlineView: 食品规则需要检测能力落地
zh-CN.headlineFull: 斯里兰卡为反式脂肪监管强化实验室能力；食品规则需要检测能力落地
zh-CN.intro: WHO记录斯里兰卡在反式脂肪监管实施前加强实验室检测与质量能力，让食品政策从标准走向可执行。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 公共健康规则只有配上可测量、可追踪的能力，才真正进入现实。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 写下限值之后，还要能在实验室里测出来。

en-US.headlineFact: Sri Lanka strengthens labs for trans-fat rules
en-US.headlineFull: Sri Lanka strengthens labs for trans-fat rules; food standards need enforcement capacity
en-US.intro: WHO reports Sri Lanka is strengthening laboratory testing and quality capacity ahead of trans-fat regulation implementation.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Public-health rules become real only when they are measurable, traceable and enforceable.
en-US.doudouQuote: After setting a limit, laboratories must be able to measure it.

sources.title: Sri Lanka strengthens laboratory capacity ahead of trans-fat regulation implementation

zh-CN.headlineFact: 67个WTO成员推进电商协议临时实施
zh-CN.headlineView: 全球数字规则从谈判转向接入
zh-CN.headlineFull: 67个WTO成员推进电商协议临时实施；全球数字规则从谈判转向接入
zh-CN.intro: 参与方覆盖约70%的全球贸易，正通过国内程序和临时安排推动首套全球数字贸易基线规则落地。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 数字贸易协议的价值，要在电子签名、无纸化和消费者信任真正接入业务流程后才释放。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 规则写完之后，系统还要真的连起来。

en-US.headlineFact: 67 WTO members advance an interim e-commerce pathway
en-US.headlineView: global digital rules move from talks to connection
en-US.headlineFull: 67 WTO members advance an interim e-commerce pathway; global digital rules move from talks to connection
en-US.intro: Participants covering about 70% of global trade are using domestic procedures and interim arrangements to implement baseline digital-trade rules.
en-US.xiaziQuote: Digital-trade rules create value when e-signatures, paperless trade and consumer trust enter real workflows.
en-US.doudouQuote: After the rules are written, the systems still have to connect.

sources.title: Members discuss preparations to bring E-Commerce Agreement into force by mid-2027

zh-CN.headlineFact: 未来五年至少一年刷新高温纪录概率达80%
zh-CN.headlineView: 高温韧性需要成为长期预算
zh-CN.headlineFull: 未来五年至少一年刷新高温纪录概率达80%；高温韧性需要成为长期预算
zh-CN.intro: WMO预计2025至2029年至少一年超过2024年最热纪录的概率为80%，极端高温准备需从应急转向常态投资。
zh-CN.xiaziQuote: 当高温从异常变成高概率事件，城市、能源和企业都要把韧性写进年度预算。
zh-CN.doudouQuote: 不能每次热浪来临，才第一次打开应急预案。

en-US.headlineFact: Record heat in at least one of five years is 80% likely
en-US.headlineView: heat resilience belongs in recurring budgets
en-US.headlineFull: Record heat in at least one of five years is 80% likely; heat resilience belongs in recurring budgets
en-US.intro: WMO estimates an 80% chance that at least one year from 2025 to 2029 will surpass 2024 as the warmest on record.
en-US.xiaziQuote: When extreme heat becomes probable, cities, energy systems and firms must budget for resilience every year.
en-US.doudouQuote: Do not open the heat plan for the first time during the heatwave.

sources.title: WMO Global Annual to Decadal Climate Update (2025-2029)
